FAQ

Common questions.

What kinds of emails can it write?
Anything work-related — follow-ups, payment reminders, rescheduling, introductions, saying no, delivering bad news and more.
Will it get the facts right?
It uses the details you give it. Read it over before you send it — it's your name on it.
Is what I enter stored?
No. What you enter is used to write your result and isn't kept afterward. The only things Workblox Business saves are your business profile and, if you use it, your Contacts list. See the Privacy Policy.
What does it cost?
Business Email Drafter is part of Workblox Business. You pick your tools and pay by how many: $25/mo for 1–3 tools, $40/mo for 4–7 tools, or $75/mo for 8–16 tools, with a 7-day free trial.
